title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for spring 2027.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for spring 2027. It will be her first sustained tour of the region since she stepped away from the road last year, and it moves her into larger U.S. headline rooms than on her previous North American run. That scale is notable because her return to performing has happened gradually, through individual shows and festivals rather than an immediate attempt to replace the tour she cancelled.

The break followed her collapse during a set at All Things Go in New York. Soon afterward, she cancelled every upcoming performance for the foreseeable future and said she needed time to work on herself, without putting a timetable on when she would return. The North American dates planned around the album disappeared with the rest of that schedule. For months, there was no replacement route waiting in the background, only the possibility that she would perform again when she felt ready.

She returned at the Grammy Awards, where "Messy" won her first Grammy for Best Pop Solo Performance and she performed the song during the ceremony. Headline shows in Britain and festival appearances followed, including a return to All Things Go after the previous year's set had ended abruptly. Those performances gave her a way back into live work without immediately committing to another long run. By the time the new tour was announced, she had already spent much of 2026 onstage again.

[apple:song:6768357139:6768357142]

New music arrived during the same stretch. "From Down Here," made with James Blake, grew out of an idea that came to her the morning after the Grammy win. She has described the song as being about missing an old high while recognizing that a more grounded life is safer and ultimately more rewarding. It is her first new release since *I'm Only F**king Myself*, and it gives the coming shows material created after the break rather than leaving the tour tied entirely to the album cycle that was interrupted.

Everything Begins takes its name from her "Everything Ends" tattoo. When she cancelled the run, she asked fans for "a second chance" once she had taken the time she needed. For months, the return was measured one performance at a time. Now the first full North American run she has committed to since then carries the phrase in reverse, attached to weeks of shows rather than a single comeback appearance and to the touring routine she stepped away from a year earlier.
